title: Lecture-to-text alignment (v1)
description: One file per lecture (/data/v1/alignments/<url-encoded lecture id>.json, listed in alignments/index.json) mapping time ranges in the recording to chapter lines. A line's range covers the whole time the line is under discussion (it can span minutes). Only lectures selected in data/audio-publish.json are published; lines that were not aligned, or aligned below its confidence floor, are absent. Within v1, fields are only added.

chapter.description: Chapter file key the lecture teaches, e.g. 'chapter_10'. Optional: added after the first v1 release.

lineId.description: id of the chapter line this range covers (chapter.schema.json $defs/line). Line ids are unique across all chapters; the build checks that the line exists in the named chapter.

confidence.description: 0..1: similarity-weighted share of the line's words heard in this range. Optional: added after the first v1 release.
